integrity: The proof reduces ideals to support subsets, uses co-singleton unique neighbors to force every coordinate minimal ideal into any total dominating set, and then handles paired domination by parity and an explicit perfect matching.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to finite direct products of fields; arbitrary reduced rings can produce nontrivial blow-ups of strong Boolean graphs.
The graph recovers the number of field factors but not their cardinalities or isomorphism types.
The finite verifier covers ranks two through five only; the general result is symbolic.
title: Total and paired domination rigidity for annihilating-ideal graphs of products of fields
